tldr: 台股週二（8/12）大漲397點收45,518點、漲幅0.88%，尾盤大單湧入帶動台積電漲20元至2,415元創新高。
台積電持續擴充CoWoS先進封裝產能、2026年底上看約12.5萬片／月，N2與封裝產能因AI需求排單至2027~2028年。
美國7月CPI年增率降至3.4%（核心2.5%）符合預期，帶動標普與那斯達克走高，強化市場對Fed下月按兵不動的預期。
8月高股息ETF除息潮8/18達高峰、單日20檔同步除息，00878配息1.01元創掛牌新高領軍。
紅海與阿曼灣船隻遇襲推升航運供給風險，油價維持強勢；台灣6月CPI年增2.6%、經濟維持韌性。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲397點收45,518 尾盤大單推台積電收最高
items.title_en: Taiex surges 397 points to 45,518 as a late order pushes TSMC to a record close
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二（8/12）開高走高，終場上漲397點收45,518點、漲幅0.88%，成交值約8,587億元。台積電尾盤湧入逾1.7萬張買單，收盤大漲20元至2,415元（漲0.84%）改寫新高，撐住盤面並帶動指數穩守45,000點之上，反映權值股買盤回流。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index opened higher and closed up 397 points on Tuesday (Aug 12) at 45,518, a 0.88% gain, on turnover of about NT$858.7bn. A flood of more than 17,000 lots hit TSMC in the closing auction, lifting the foundry giant NT$20 to a record NT$2,415 (up 0.84%) and anchoring the advance as the index extended its push above the 45,000 mark.

items.title_zh: 台積電領軍權值股走高 盤中一度攻上45,407點
items.title_en: TSMC-led tech heavyweights drive the rally as index reclaims ground intraday
items.summary_zh: 盤中買盤集中科技權值股，台積電一度上漲約10元至2,405元，加權指數盤中大漲逾280點至45,407點，尾盤再受大單拉抬。AI伺服器與半導體供應鏈個股續居盤面核心，市場領漲面雖集中但氣勢穩健，投資人圍繞台積電創高布局，帶動整體多方格局延續。
items.summary_en: Buying concentrated in technology heavyweights through the session, with TSMC trading up around NT$10 to NT$2,405 and the Taiex advancing more than 280 points intraday to 45,407 before the late surge. AI-server and semiconductor supply-chain names stayed at the center of activity, keeping the market's leadership narrow but firm as investors positioned around the foundry leader's record-setting move.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS持續擴產 AI封裝需求排單至2028
items.title_en: TSMC keeps ramping CoWoS as AI packaging demand runs into 2028
items.summary_zh: 法人估台積電CoWoS先進封裝產能2026年底上看約12.5萬片／月、2027年底約17萬片，高階AI加速器幾乎全數仰賴其產線。CoWoS-L／S產能被指全數售罄，N2訂單已排至2027下半年至2028年，HBM三強2026年產能亦鎖定至2027年，凸顯AI算力供應鏈持續緊俏，支撐台廠中長期成長動能。
items.summary_en: Institutional estimates have TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity climbing toward roughly 125K wafers per month by end-2026 and about 170K by end-2027, with high-end AI accelerators almost wholly dependent on its lines. CoWoS-L/S capacity is described as sold out, N2 orders are booked into late-2027 and 2028, and HBM suppliers are locked out through 2027, underscoring how tight the AI compute supply chain remains.

items.title_zh: AI伺服器與先進封裝族群 續居2026供應鏈焦點
items.title_en: AI server and advanced-packaging plays anchor 2026 supply-chain focus
items.summary_zh: 法人持續點名AI伺服器組裝、先進封裝、HBM與矽晶圓為2026資本支出循環核心受惠者，SoIC應用自AMD向NVIDIA、Broadcom延伸、預計2027年後放量。此意味AI建置潮正把台灣硬體供應鏈更廣泛族群——從板類、散熱到電源管理——一併拉進上升軌道，而非僅集中於晶圓代工龍頭，帶動題材輪動。
items.summary_en: Analysts continue to flag AI-server assembly, advanced packaging, HBM and silicon-wafer suppliers as the core beneficiaries of 2026's capital-spending cycle, with SoIC adoption widening beyond AMD toward Nvidia and Broadcom from 2027. The read-through is that the AI build-out is pulling a broader slice of Taiwan's hardware chain — from boards and cooling to power management — into the upcycle rather than concentrating gains in the foundry leader alone.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准台新銀行合併新光銀行 金融整併再進一步
items.title_en: FSC clears Taishin's merger with Shin Kong Bank, advancing sector consolidation
items.summary_zh: 金管會已同意台新國際商業銀行合併臺灣新光商業銀行，為台新新光金控旗下整併再邁一步，也是中型銀行持續整併的指標。此核准掃除整合分行通路與資產負債表的重要法規障礙，顯示金管會對具規模效益的整併案持開放態度，可望帶動國內銀行業版圖重整與競爭態勢調整。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has approved Taishin International Bank's merger with Shin Kong Commercial Bank, a further step in the tie-up under Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding and a marker of continued consolidation among mid-sized banks. The approval clears a key regulatory hurdle for integrating branch networks and balance sheets, and signals the FSC's willingness to let scale-building deals proceed within the domestic banking sector.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁金控共同行銷與子公司減資規範
items.title_en: FSC eases holding-company cross-marketing and capital-reduction rules
items.summary_zh: 金管會修正金融控股公司子公司間共同行銷管理辦法及子公司減資辦法相關條文，旨在給予金控更大營運彈性。搭配近期對合作金庫信用卡缺失的行政處分，顯示金管會一方面鬆綁業務規範、一方面維持行為面監理，於銀行體系間取得平衡，兼顧金控綜效與消費者權益保障。
items.summary_en: The regulator has amended rules governing cross-marketing between financial-holding subsidiaries and the capital-reduction procedures for such subsidiaries, part of a push to give conglomerates more operating flexibility. Alongside a recent sanction on Cooperative Bank over credit-card lapses, the moves show the FSC balancing looser business rules with continued conduct enforcement across the banking system.

items.title_zh: 8月ETF除息潮8/18登場 20檔同步除息、00878配息創高
items.title_en: August ETF ex-dividend wave peaks Aug 18 with 20 funds and a record 00878 payout
items.summary_zh: 台灣8月高股息ETF除息旺季集中在8月18日，當日共20檔股票型ETF同步除息，涵蓋00878、00881、00891、00919、00929等。國泰永續高股息（00878）宣布每單位配息1.01元，較上期0.66元增加約53%、為掛牌以來新高，亦首度突破1元，使本月成為存股族關注焦點，需在殖利率與含息總報酬間權衡。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's August high-yield ETF ex-dividend season concentrates on Aug 18, when 20 equity ETFs go ex-dividend the same day, including 00878, 00881, 00891, 00919 and 00929. Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) declared NT$1.01 per unit — up about 53% from the prior NT$0.66 and a record since listing, its first payout above NT$1 — making the month a focal point for income-oriented investors weighing yield against total return.

items.title_zh: 不只看殖利率：填息能力成選股關鍵
items.title_en: Beyond yield: filling the dividend gap becomes the selection test
items.summary_zh: 8月逾30檔台股ETF配息、殖利率差異大，00881以近9%居首，但顧問提醒殖利率僅是一環。挑選時更應比較填息能力、含息總報酬、配息來源、費用與成分股配置，以免落入「領到高配息、資產卻沒增加」的陷阱。對高資產與存股族而言，兼顧配息與資本利得的整體報酬，才是財富管理的核心考量。
items.summary_en: With more than 30 Taiwan equity ETFs distributing in August and headline yields ranging widely — 00881 topping the list near 9% — advisers are stressing that raw yield is only part of the picture. Selecting for ex-dividend recovery (填息) ability, total return including dividends, payout sources, fees and constituent mix matters more, so investors avoid the trap of collecting high distributions while overall assets stagnate.

items.title_zh: 自住房地出售 續享房地合一400萬免稅額
items.title_en: Owner-occupier home sales keep NT$4mn tax-free allowance under house-and-land tax
items.summary_zh: 依房地合一所得稅制，個人出售符合條件之自住房地可享免稅所得額400萬元，超過部分按最低稅率10%課徵。若於移轉登記日2年內出售舊屋並購入自住新屋，符合條件者可申請退還出售舊屋所繳稅款。對財富規劃者而言，安排不動產交易時序以保全優惠，仍是重要提醒，避免因時點錯置而喪失退稅資格。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's consolidated house-and-land income tax, individuals selling a qualifying owner-occupied property retain a tax-free gain of NT$4mn, with any excess taxed at a preferential 10% rate. Sellers who buy a replacement owner-occupied home within two years of the transfer can also apply to reclaim the tax paid on the old home, a reminder for wealth planners to sequence property transactions carefully to preserve the relief.

items.title_zh: 遺產贈與稅級距2026調整 累積物價漲逾一成觸發
items.title_en: Estate and gift tax brackets adjusted for 2026 as cumulative inflation tops 10%
items.summary_zh: 財政部2026年遺產稅與贈與稅方案維持免稅額不變，但因累計消費者物價漲幅超過10%的法定門檻，課稅級距隨之調整放寬。對高資產家庭而言，級距調整可略為減輕大額移轉的實質稅負，值得依更新後門檻重新檢視傳承與贈與規劃，把握級距調整帶來的節稅空間。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance's 2026 estate- and gift-tax schedule keeps the exemption amounts unchanged but widens the tax brackets, because cumulative consumer-price inflation exceeded the 10% threshold that triggers a statutory adjustment. For high-net-worth families the bracket shift modestly eases the effective burden on larger transfers, making it worth revisiting succession and gifting plans against the updated thresholds.

items.title_zh: 台灣經濟維持韌性 2026全年成長上看近雙位數
items.title_en: Taiwan's economy stays resilient with 2026 growth seen near double digits
items.summary_zh: 主計總處資料顯示，2026年第1季初步經濟成長維持強勁，並預測全年GDP成長約9.6%、每人GDP約4萬5,610美元，動能來自AI帶動的出口與科技投資。此一穩健軌道給予政策當局維持貨幣政策穩定的空間，同時觀察下半年外需與新台幣走勢變化，兼顧成長與物價穩定的平衡。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's official statistics agency (DGBAS) puts first-quarter 2026 preliminary growth at a strong pace and forecasts full-year 2026 GDP growth around 9.6%, with per-capita GDP near US$45,610, powered by AI-driven exports and technology investment. The robust trajectory gives policymakers room to keep monetary settings steady while watching how external demand and the New Taiwan dollar evolve through the second half.

items.title_zh: 6月CPI年增2.6% 通膨可控但仍偏高
items.title_en: June CPI up 2.6% keeps inflation manageable but above target midpoint
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月消費者物價指數年增2.6%、上半年平均約漲1.7%，通膨維持可控但仍高於央行理想區間。景氣對策信號本季稍早一度亮出代表過熱的「紅燈」，顯示經濟熱度偏高；綜合來看，數據支持央行維持政策穩定，而物價壓力與強勁景氣仍是後續利率決策的關鍵觀察變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June consumer price index rose 2.6% from a year earlier, with the first-half average up about 1.7%, leaving inflation contained yet running above the central bank's comfort zone. The monitoring indicator flashed a "red light" earlier in the quarter, signalling a hot economy; together the readings support a steady-policy stance while price pressure and strong activity remain the key variables for the CBC.

items.title_zh: 美國通膨降溫 提振風險偏好、強化Fed按兵不動預期
items.title_en: Cooler US inflation lifts risk appetite and firms Fed-hold expectations
items.summary_zh: 美國7月通膨數據優於市場憂慮，強化Fed下次會議維持政策不變的預期，提振全球風險情緒與台股相關科技族群。物價壓力向目標靠攏，被市場解讀為有利AI與半導體股的環境，而這正是台股指數的核心權值，有助說明本地市場與美股同步走高、改寫新高的背景。
items.summary_en: Softer-than-feared US July inflation data reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve leaves policy unchanged at its next meeting, buoying global risk sentiment and Taiwan-relevant technology names. With price pressures easing toward target, markets read the backdrop as supportive for AI and semiconductor equities that dominate Taiwan's index, helping explain the local market's push to fresh highs alongside gains on Wall Street.

items.title_zh: 紅海與阿曼灣船隻遇襲 油價維持強勢
items.title_en: Oil holds firm as Red Sea and Gulf of Oman attacks raise shipping risk
items.summary_zh: 紅海與阿曼灣船隻遭攻擊、造成人員傷亡，加深市場對全球航運路線的疑慮，布蘭特原油維持在80美元中後段。中東供給路線緊張帶來的能源價格風險居高不下，對高度仰賴進口的台灣是重要變數，將牽動通膨與投入成本，即便美國整體通膨降溫趨勢仍未改變。
items.summary_en: Crude prices stayed firm after deadly attacks on vessels in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman heightened concerns over global shipping routes, with Brent trading near the high-US$80s. Sustained energy-price risk from Middle East supply-route tensions is a swing factor for import-dependent Taiwan, feeding into inflation and input costs even as the broader disinflation trend in the US remains intact.

items.title_zh: 美國7月CPI年增3.4% 符合市場預期（2026-08-12）
items.title_en: US July CPI rises 3.4% annually, in line with forecasts (2026-08-12)
items.summary_zh: 美國7月CPI月增0.1%、年增率3.4%，較6月回落0.1個百分點；剔除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.2%、年增2.5%，均符合道瓊調查預期。溫和數據緩解通膨再起疑慮，也讓Fed於9月會議維持利率不變的預期得以延續，成為當日市場情緒的主要支撐。
items.summary_en: US consumer prices rose 0.1% in July for a 3.4% annual rate, down 0.1 point from June, while core CPI (ex-food and energy) rose 0.2% for a 2.5% annual rate, both matching Dow Jones consensus. The tame print eased fears of renewed price pressure and kept alive the case for the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady at its September meeting.

items.title_zh: 標普與那斯達克收高 反映通膨數據降溫（2026-08-12）
items.title_en: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close higher after inflation report (2026-08-12)
items.summary_zh: 美股小幅走高，投資人消化較預期溫和的通膨數據，標普500上漲約0.3%、科技股居重的那斯達克綜合指數漲約0.5%，道瓊則收在平盤附近。物價數據放緩強化Fed下月按兵不動的預期，使科技股領漲格局延續，並支撐晶片與AI相關股的市場情緒。
items.summary_en: US stocks edged higher as investors digested the cooler inflation reading, with the S&P 500 up about 0.3% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite adding roughly 0.5%, while the Dow finished near flat. Moderating price data reinforced expectations the Fed will stand pat next month, keeping technology leadership intact and supporting sentiment across chip and AI-linked shares.

items.title_zh: 7月通膨仍具黏性 Fed料維持謹慎（2026-08-12）
items.title_en: July inflation stays sticky, keeping Fed cautious (2026-08-12)
items.summary_zh: 分析指出，7月通膨雖符合預期，但仍高於Fed 2%目標，顯示物價壓力具黏性，使央行沒有急於降息的理由。此份報告讓Fed短期內傾向維持政策不變，一面權衡仍偏高的通膨、一面觀察逐漸降溫的勞動市場，凸顯政策路徑的謹慎基調。
items.summary_en: Analysts noted July's inflation, while in line with forecasts, remained above the Fed's 2% goal and showed price pressure is proving stubborn, giving the central bank little reason to rush toward rate cuts. The report leaves the Fed positioned to keep policy on hold in the near term as it weighs still-elevated inflation against signs of a cooling labor market.

items.title_zh: 紅海、阿曼灣船隻遇襲後油價變動有限（2026-08-12）
items.title_en: Oil little changed after Red Sea, Gulf of Oman ship attacks (2026-08-12)
items.summary_zh: 油價週三變動有限，紅海與阿曼灣船隻遭致命攻擊，重新引發市場對全球航運路線與中東供給風險的疑慮。交易員在地緣供給溢價與充裕產量、需求訊號之間權衡，使指標原油維持近期漲幅、未進一步大幅走高，反映風險與基本面拉鋸下的僵持格局。
items.summary_en: Oil prices were little changed on Wednesday after deadly attacks on vessels in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman renewed concerns over risks to global shipping routes and Middle East supply. Traders balanced the geopolitical supply premium against ample production and demand signals, leaving benchmark crude holding recent gains rather than extending sharply higher.
